data.narrative:
Vantage Robotics is a Series C-stage defense and security robotics company that has raised $45.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 12 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI. The peer set ranges from $300M to $18.0B in valuation, with a median of $2.3B.

Two methods triangulate to a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage advancement to the $46M capital-raised proxy, implying a $78M valuation. Peer-median methodology anchors to the $2.3B median across the 12-company comparable set, reflecting the scale and capital intensity of late-stage defense tech. These methods produce a low bound of $66M and a high bound of $2.7B.

The triangulated range of $66M to $2.7B reflects material uncertainty around market positioning and customer traction. The stage-progression method yields a floor estimate, while peer-median suggests substantially higher value if Vantage captures market share commensurate with leading competitors. Key uncertainties center on product differentiation, defense procurement velocity, and capital efficiency relative to the peer cohort. A median valuation of $1.2B balances these methods, though placement within the range depends on commercial momentum not fully visible in available data.
